rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for strongly wanting something or wanting to do something.

example.english: I yearn to go to Japan to see the cherry blossoms.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 soeng2 heoi3 jat6 bun2 tai2 jing1 faa1

rows.note: Use this when the desire is especially urgent, often for an action the speaker wishes they could do immediately.

example.english: I yearn to rush out the door right now.
example.traditional: 我恨不得而家即刻衝出門口。
example.jyutping: ngo5 han6 bat1 dak1 ji4 gaa1 zik1 hak1 cung1 ceot1 mun4 hau2

rows.note: Use this formal or written choice for an expressed or enduring longing, especially in serious prose.

example.english: They continue to yearn to return home after many years away.
example.traditional: 佢哋離鄉多年，仍然渴望返屋企。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 lei4 hoeng1 do1 nin4 jing4 jin4 hot3 mong6 faan1 uk1 kei2
